sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
2.4.8 — Mobile Task Manager CRM & Layout Optimizations

  • Mobile Layout Streamlining: Replaced cluttered card views with flat, Notion-style task list rows and clear chronological headers (Today, Tomorrow, Upcoming).
  • iOS-Style Bottom Drawer: Re-engineered the task details drawer to slide up from the bottom on mobile viewports with soft drag handles and touch-friendly controls.
  • One-Tap Status Cycling: Added instantaneous task state cycling (To-Do, In Progress, Client Review, Done) directly from the task list rows.
  • Visual Details: Integrated soft assignee avatars, color-coded priority flags, and custom dropdown indicators.
  • Dashboard Fix: Resolved text greeting overlap issues on the main admin dashboard view.
